column3: A question about the time being near replaces the statement that building houses is not near.
“I” replaces the third-person subject of bringing out.
The repeated “your brothers” is recast, “fellow exiles” is added, and the command to stay far becomes a statement about them.
“Within them” replaces “within you”; the removal from their flesh is shortened.
The heart of the detestable things is not retained.
